sentences.text: Morena Silva de Vaz Setta Baccarin -LRB- -LSB- moˈɾenɐ ˈbakaɾĩ -RSB- ; born June 2 , 1979 -RRB- is a Brazilian American actress .	Brazilian	Brazilian people	American	American people	Brazilian American	Brazilian Americans
